title: WaterColor "A Coastal Indulgence" 89 Running Oak Circle
h1: WaterColor "A Coastal Indulgence" 89 Running Oak Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 16 wristbands.- Private pool and sitting spa. Pool & spa are heated together. **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $70 per day**- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- 6 adult bikes - Fabulous outdoor space- Spacious third-floor living area- Elevator- Two primary suites- Impeccably furnished- 3 dedicated parking spots. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Savor an elevated 30A getaway at A Coastal Indulgence. Tucked within coveted WaterColor, this stunning 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom home comfortably accommodates 16 guests. Revel in WaterColor’s resort-style amenities, including the famed beach club and family-friendly Camp WaterColor. Boasting an idyllic outdoor space and with the sugar-soft beach only a 5-minute bike ride away, this exceptional property is a perfect escape for a peaceful, pampered vacation.Coastal elegance and rustic elements combine throughout this sprawling 3-story home, creating an enchanting setting for letting worries slip away—whether relaxing with a movie in the impeccably furnished living space, or gathering for an intimate dinner at the 8-person dining table. Culinary-inclined guests will love the gourmet kitchen’s Thermador appliances and dual dishwashers for breezy cleanup. French doors lead outside, where a picturesque oasis awaits. Enjoy succulent barbecue dinners at the outdoor kitchen and 6-person patio table. The private pool beckons for a mid-day refresh, or enjoy a tasty cocktail at the bar, complete with 3 stools and a mounted TV. A high-top table to the side provides extra seating for 3. When the sun disappears beneath the horizon, delight in the ambiance of the outdoor fireplace while enjoying a late-night soak in the sitting spa. Retreat for a restful night in the luxurious primary bedroom or the lovely guest bedroom; each features a king bed, and the primary bedroom includes a private bathroom.The convenient in-home elevator makes it easy for guests to ascend to the second level, where a lavish primary bedroom and 2 beautiful guest bedrooms invite relaxation—each with a soft king bed, private bathroom, and access to a furnished porch.The third-level living space encourages indoor fun with a Foosball table, TV, Xbox, wet bar, and a queen bed. The neighboring bunk room has plenty of sleeping accommodations for additional guests with 1 queen bed, 2 twin beds, and 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.A Coastal Indulgence has everything guests need for a deluxe 30A vacation, including parking for 3 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, visit WaterColor Beach Club or use the access point on Goldenrod Circle next to WaterColor Inn. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Two Twin Beds, Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower- Living Area: Queen BedWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
